name: io.github.anipotts/imessage-mcp
title: iMessage MCP
description: Read-only MCP for iMessage, SMS, MMS, and RCS history already present in Apple Messages on Mac.

environmentVariables.name: IMESSAGE_DB
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a live or faithfully copied Mac chat.db. Defaults to the current user's Messages database.

environmentVariables.name: IMESSAGE_CONTACTS
environmentVariables.description: Use the authorized live unified contact store or handles only. Values: live, none. Privacy-first setup uses none; the live database runtime default is live.

environmentVariables.name: IMESSAGE_PRIVACY
environmentVariables.description: Startup disclosure ceiling. Values: full, redacted, aggregate. Privacy-first setup uses redacted; stdio runtime defaults to full and HTTP to redacted.

environmentVariables.name: IMESSAGE_ATTACHMENT_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to permit explicit full-mode attachment-path requests.

environmentVariables.name: IMESSAGE_REFERENCE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The opaque-reference key is generated on first run in the state directory; set this to pin it to an operator-owned 0600 regular file of at least 32 random bytes.

environmentVariables.name: IMESSAGE_DATABASE_ID_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The database-lineage identity is generated on first run in the state directory; set this to pin a copy to the original lineage through an operator-owned 0600 regular file.
